channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jonathon Simmons | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jonathon Simmons from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Dennis Lindsey on Jonathon Simmons, David Nwaba
item.description:
“Every so often a club will catch lightning in a bottle with a Jonathon Simmons of the world or a David Nwaba, but a lot of good local, high school, college talent that these guys deserve and want a shot,”

Dennis Lindsey on Jonathon Simmons, David Nwaba, Sep 22, 2018. Source: Deseret News.

item.title: Dennis Lindsey on Jonathon Simmons
item.description:
Dennis Lindsey said of Simmons.

“We actually had him in Utah Jazz mini-camp and he played very well and we hesitated so there’s a lot of pieces to Jonathon Simmons, but the San Antonio franchise should be proud that they helped him get in the league,although he’s now in Orlando.”

Dennis Lindsey on Jonathon Simmons, Sep 22, 2018. Source: Deseret News.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Jonathon Simmons
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on Simmons' homecoming tonight:

“It’s going to be great to see him. I can’t wait. He’s got a big heart and he’s come a long way.”

Gregg Popovich on Jonathon Simmons, Oct 10, 2017. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Jonathon Simmons
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on Simmons stepping up in playoffs:

“He's shown a propensityto not be intimidated by the moment or anything like that.”

Gregg Popovich on Jonathon Simmons, May 16, 2017. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Jonathon Simmons
item.description:
Kevin Durant:

“They just keep doing it, no matter who’s out on the court, running that system. Somebody goes down, somebody steps in. It’s not like they gave the ball to Jonathan Simmons and said, `Go score for us.’They ran a perfect offense against that defense and Coach Pop put them in great position to use their strengths. That’s just the Spurs, man. That’s why I have the utmost respect for them.”

Kevin Durant on Jonathon Simmons, May 13, 2017. Source: San Antonio Express-News.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on James Harden, Jonathon Simmons
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on Simmons facing Harden again:

“He's a competitive guy…It's a great opportunity to see what you can do against a great player.”

Gregg Popovich on James Harden, Jonathon Simmons, May 11, 2017. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard on Jonathon Simmons
item.description:
Tom Osborn:Kawhi on Simmons' chase-down block in 4Q:

“Definitely a momentum change. Seeing him racing down that floor to get a block is just amazing.”

Kawhi Leonard on Jonathon Simmons, Feb 1, 2017. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Jonathon Simmons
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Gregg Popovich on Jonathon Simmons:

“The guy has played about a minute and a half in the NBA. I'm not going to label him. He's a work in progress.”

Gregg Popovich on Jonathon Simmons, Nov 4, 2016. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Jonathon Simmons
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Gregg Popovich on Jonathon Simmons:

“He's letting the game come to him. He's more consistent. There will be ups & downs, but I'm really happy for him because he has shown that he will have an NBA career.”

Gregg Popovich on Jonathon Simmons, Oct 30, 2016. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.
